config.deviation: Two knobs added to the mb2 tuning, both about APL's non-Kenyon-cell output, because with the mb2 tuning exactly as chosen every glutamatergic PAM-compartment MBON (MBON01-07) is silent for every input: APL delivers -3198 mV to MBON01 and -3736 mV to MBON05 in one 50 ms window against 259 and 169 mV of Kenyon-cell excitation. APL is a non-spiking graded interneuron in vivo and this kernel has no graded transmission, so it fires at ~250 Hz and dumps its full synapse-count weight as spike-triggered inhibition. With the reward arm of the plasticity rule (depress KC -> avoidance MBON in PAM compartments) landing entirely on silent cells, the experiment would be a guaranteed null for a reason that has nothing to do with learning. apl_kc_only=1 restricts apl_scale=2 to APL -> KC (its documented sparsening role, 94% of its output weight); apl_mbon_scale=0.1 scales the 72 APL -> MBON synapses. The Kenyon-cell code is essentially unchanged: 212 vs 186 active per state, always-on 0.046 vs 0.042. The mb2 tuning is still run as a condition (tuning=spec) so the silenced-reward-arm result is on the record.
